title: Unveiling Na2Fe2S2O oxychalcogenide: a high-performance thermoelectric and optoelectronic material for sustainable energy conversion
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00456J, Paper
Muhammad Haseeb, Muhammad Kashif Bashir, Athar Javed, Asma Munir, Muhammad Amir Rafiq, Altaf Hussain
This study presents a computational study of Na2Fe2S2O, highlighting its structure, stability, electronic and optical properties, bonding, charge density, thermoelectric performance, and device potential.
